reading.title: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
reading.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

news.title: Counting under way in Holborn and St Pancras byelection – UK politics live
news.summary: Results are expected from 2.30am BST in the north London poll to choose a replacement for former PM Keir Starmer Party officials are gathering as the result is expected imminently. From the count here in Camden council’s swanky headquarters, signs suggest a Labour-win is imminent. Continue reading...
